dimensions.name: Source-native ID
dimensions.required: Stable provider-native identifier preserved through pagination, replay and detail enrichment.

dimensions.name: Provider slug + domain aliases
dimensions.required: One provider family per slug; host aliases are reviewed and provider-scoped, never a new provider per hostname.

dimensions.name: Metadata-only record
dimensions.required: Discovery never fabricates an Offer, playback URL, language track or quality claim.

dimensions.name: Pagination completeness
dimensions.required: Bounded page walk with a verified terminal condition; an empty page is not automatically terminal.

dimensions.name: Checkpoint / resume
dimensions.required: Per-provider, per-partition cursor committed only after the page is persisted; resume does not restart page one.

dimensions.name: Interruption handling
dimensions.required: Operator interrupt / budget exhaustion / crash leaves a PARTIAL state and a committed checkpoint.

dimensions.name: Replay / idempotency
dimensions.required: Exact replay reports unchanged without rewriting rows or advancing updated_at.

dimensions.name: Deduplication
dimensions.required: Native ID wins over URL; tracking-only URL variants collapse; same title on different URLs stays separate.

dimensions.name: Typed canonical reconciliation
dimensions.required: Explicit Movie/TVSeries evidence; identity is (tmdb_id, content_type); anime/episode count never guesses type.

dimensions.name: Identity uncertainty
dimensions.required: Unclassified rows persist as PENDING and never project to canonical mappings or offers.

dimensions.name: Request budget / rate
dimensions.required: Attempt-level accounting including robots, redirects and retries; min interval; operator and provider caps (lower wins).

dimensions.name: Error classification / fail-closed
dimensions.required: 403/429/404/JS-challenge/robots/DNS/redirect each map to a distinct state; policy errors are not swallowed.

dimensions.name: Permission + robots grant
dimensions.required: No dispatch without a reviewed grant; robots crawl-delay honoured; no credential/cookie/auth forwarding.

dimensions.name: Config drift / self-healing scope
dimensions.required: Learned recipes cannot widen approved hosts, paths, rates, auth or write scope.

dimensions.name: Runtime / dependency cost
dimensions.required: Startup, memory, packaging and maintenance compared with Python/Django collectors.

dimensions.name: Test determinism
dimensions.required: Fixture-only, no live source traffic, fake clock/transport, disposable DB.

dimensions.name: Credential / token handling
dimensions.required: No storage or sharing of cookies/tokens; local-only mode; no secret in fixtures or prompts.

go_no_go_criteria: A pinned, integrity-reviewed upstream commit exists.
An offline fixture POC reproduces all six provider contracts on every dimension above.
A reviewed permission grant exists for any source it would touch (#124); none does today.
The adapter cannot widen host/path/rate/auth/write scope during self-repair.
Runtime/packaging cost is justified against the current Python collectors.
No production code is refactored before the parity evidence is reviewed.
